choose.title: Choose
choose.body: Pick a service, a specialist and a location. No calls, no messages.

time.body: Only real free slots — double bookings are blocked automatically.

booked.body: Confirmation by email, and one tap to add it to Google or Apple Calendar.

calendar.body: See everyone's day side by side. Uponco fills it from your booking page and keeps double bookings out.

points.oneCalendar: Every location, service and team member in one place.
points.edits: Add, move or cancel a booking in a few taps.

calendar.alt: Studio North's team calendar: a day view with three barbers' bookings side by side

embed.title: One line of code. Your whole booking flow.
embed.body: Paste one script tag into your website and the full booking flow appears — nothing to configure.

deepLinks.title: Links that arrive ready
deepLinks.body: Share links that open with a service, a specialist or a location already chosen — perfect for ads, posts and messages.

embed.alt: The booking flow embedded on a business's own website

hours.alt: The schedule screen with a week of working hours

group.body: Set a capacity for classes. Connect Google and online bookings get a Meet link automatically.
